The fastest way to make the image boot on more hardware, or boot at all, is to write more hand-written Rust in the platform runtime — which is exactly the code that never gets verified. Every hour spent making it boot sooner is an hour that adds unverified surface, and the resulting code is load-bearing enough that nobody wants to rewrite it later in Thermite.

